title: Multimodal Characterization of Movement Trajectories in Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy
official: Prospective Observational Cohort Study to Quantitatively Characterize Movement Patterns and Their Longitudinal Trajectories in Chronic Inflammatory Demyelinating Polyneuropathy Using an Xsens Inertial Measurement Suit and Smartwatch Sensors
summary: This prospective, longitudinal study aims to evaluate the usefulness of high-resolution whole-body motion data captured by wearable sensors to assess functional status and longitudinal changes in CIDP (chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy) patients undergoing treatment. Close clinical monitoring will complement sensor-based movement data to investigate whether detailed kinematic measures can capture motor impairments and changes that are only partially reflected by established clinical scores.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (CIDP) according to current EAN/PNS diagnostic criteria
* Age ≥18 years
* Ability to understand and perform the standardized movement protocol safely
* Written informed consent prior to study participation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Additional neurological diseases that substantially affect motor function as evaluated by the principal investigator
* Relevant orthopedic or rheumatological conditions that substantially influence movement performance as determined by the principal investigator
